about: The rules of motioncheck.py, read at start: rule: [severity, what was found, why it matters, how to fix it]. Severity is critical, high, medium or low; the script's own code decides when each rule fires.

no-reduced-motion: animations, and no prefers-reduced-motion rule in the project
movement on screen makes some people dizzy or sick; they ask their system for less
add @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) rules that swap movement for a fade or nothing
cdn: animation code or a Lottie file loaded from another host
it sees each visitor's IP address, and a file changed there runs in your app (privacy and supply chain)
install the package with the app's own package manager and import it, so the app serves it; copy Lottie files into the repo
layout: the page is laid out again on every frame: phones stutter
animate transform (translate, scale) or opacity; to open and close: grid-template-rows 0fr to 1fr
infinite: an animation that never stops, outside a reduced-motion guard
movement longer than 5 seconds must pause or stop (WCAG 2.2.2), and it drains batteries
put it in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference), or stop its selector in a reduce block
raf: a requestAnimationFrame loop that never ends, and no pause in this file
stop the loop when an IntersectionObserver says it is off-screen, and on visibilitychange
library: an animation library, and no script asks for reduced motion
check matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') and show the end state or one still frame
video: a video plays by itself and has no controls
add controls or a pause button of your own, and do not autoplay for reduced motion
transition-all: every property that changes animates, layout ones too
name the properties: transition: transform ..., opacity ...
duration: a transition time outside 80 ms to 1 s
under 80 ms nobody sees it; over 1 s people wait
use the motion tokens: about 120 ms for small changes, 200 to 400 ms for larger ones
will-change: each one keeps a layer in memory; many slow a phone down
remove it; add it to one element only after you measured a problem there
